fixed_time_ablation.choice: first available time and lexicographic disjoint pair; independent of range

surface.validation: All pairs in 1-second time blocks floor((frame-1)/20)%3==1; remaining blocks train
surface.starts: two flat graphs at median observed y +/- median sqrt(rho_train^2-baseline_train^2)/2
surface.domain: min/max observed pose x, padded on each side by half maximum inter-agent baseline
surface.chart: observed Cartesian x/y; y coefficients relative to median observed pose y
surface.optimizer: damped Gauss-Newton with envelope Jacobian, safeguarded line search, same-side specular roots
surface.validation_covariates: Chart uses all observed poses (known covariates), no held-out response; initial height uses training ranges only

env.association: minimum Euclidean distance to SURF contact, using no evaluation information

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: trajectory seed across all scene/noise/vehicle variants
evaluation.pilot_ci_warning: Only two independent development seeds: intervals exploratory, not population performance bounds

streams.scene: deterministic fixed physical family; no random draw
streams.optimizer: deterministic symmetric multistart, no random draw
